 Require Import Program.Equality.
 
+Lemma disj_subtyping_union_source : forall A B C,
+  (t_union A B) <: C -> A <: C /\ B <: C.
+Proof.
+  intros A B C Hsub.
+  remember (t_union A B) as source eqn:Hsource.
+  induction Hsub; inversion Hsource; subst;
+    intuition auto using s_top, s_orb, s_orc.
+Qed.
+
+Lemma disj_no_common_atom : forall A B,
+  A *a B ->
+  forall C, C <> t_bot -> (forall X Y, C <> t_union X Y) ->
+  C <: A -> C <: B -> False.
+Proof.
+  intros A B Hdisj.
+  induction Hdisj; intros T Hbot Hunion Hleft Hright.
+  all: let invert_subtyping H :=
+    inversion H; subst;
+      try solve [apply Hbot; reflexivity | eapply Hunion; reflexivity] in
+    let use_ih :=
+      solve [apply (IHHdisj1 T Hbot Hunion); assumption |
+             apply (IHHdisj2 T Hbot Hunion); assumption] in
+    solve [
+      invert_subtyping Hleft
+    | invert_subtyping Hright
+    | invert_subtyping Hleft; invert_subtyping Hright
+    | invert_subtyping Hleft; use_ih
+    | invert_subtyping Hright; use_ih
+    ].
+Qed.
+
 Theorem Disj_soundness : forall A B, A *a B -> A *s B.
+Proof.
+  intros A B Hdisj C.
+  induction C; intros [Hleft Hright].
+  all: try solve [
+    exfalso; refine (disj_no_common_atom A B Hdisj _ _ _ Hleft Hright);
+      discriminate
+  ].
+  - apply bl_bot.
+  - apply disj_subtyping_union_source in Hleft as [Hleft1 Hleft2].
+    apply disj_subtyping_union_source in Hright as [Hright1 Hright2].
+    apply bl_or; auto.
+Qed.
+
+Lemma disj_symmetric : forall A B, A *a B -> B *a A.
+Proof.
+  intros A B Hdisj.
+  induction Hdisj; auto using disjointness.
+Qed.
 
 Theorem Disj_completeness : forall A B, A *s B -> A *a B.
+Proof.
+  induction A; intros B Hspec.
+  all: try solve [apply ad_btml].
+  all: try solve [
+    apply ad_orl; [apply IHA1 | apply IHA2];
+      intros C [Hleft Hright]; apply Hspec; split;
+      eauto using s_orb, s_orc
+  ].
+  all: revert Hspec; induction B; intro Hspec.
+  all: try solve [constructor].
+  all: try solve [
+    apply ad_orr; apply disj_symmetric; [apply IHB1 | apply IHB2];
+      intros C [Hleft Hright]; apply Hspec; split;
+      eauto using s_orb, s_orc
+  ].
+  (* The arrow with a top domain and bottom codomain is below every arrow. *)
+  all: exfalso;
+    let refute C :=
+      assert (Hbottom : bottomlike C) by
+        (apply Hspec; split; auto using s_top, s_int, s_unit, s_arrow, s_bot);
+      (inversion Hbottom) in
+    first [refute t_top | refute t_int | refute t_unit |
+           refute (t_arrow t_top t_bot)].
+Qed.
